4 WebSocket endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter

## Feeds

### Aggregates (Per Minute)

`AM.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/futures` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/futures` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/futures/aggregates-per-minute.md)

Stream minute-by-minute aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified futures contract ticker via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a future ticker or use * to subscribe to all future tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple future tickers. You can retrieve available future tickers from our Futures Contracts API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym v dv o c h l n s e`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 10-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

Stream second-by-second aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified futures contract ticker via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a future ticker or use * to subscribe to all future tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple future tickers. You can retrieve available future tickers from our Futures Contracts API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym v dv o c h l n s e`

### Quotes

`Q.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/futures` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/futures` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/futures/quotes.md)

Stream BBO (Best Bid and Offer) quote data for futures tickers via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a future ticker or use * to subscribe to all future tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple future tickers. You can retrieve available future tickers from our Futures Contracts API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym bp bs bt ap as at t`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 10-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Trades

`T.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/futures` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/futures` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/futures/trades.md)

Stream tick-level trade data for futures tickers via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a future ticker or use * to subscribe to all future tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple future tickers. You can retrieve available future tickers from our Futures Contracts API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym p s t q`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 10-min delayed · Advanced Real-time
